name: Syndicate Collector
desc: A Syndicate debt collector, polite for about the first minute.

intro: A neat person with a data slate asks whether you have a moment to discuss the balance outstanding. Their other hand is already inside their coat.
A collector in a very good coat reads you a sum, with interest, and seems truly sorry when you don't reach for your wallet.
hit: A small pistol comes out of a sleeve and fires twice at you, and the collector makes a note on the slate.
The slate cracks you across the jaw. "Late fee," the collector says.
The collector steps in close, straightens your collar, and puts the pistol against your ribs.
miss: The sleeve pistol spits past your ear. "That was your first reminder," the collector says.
You knock the pistol aside, and the collector sighs and adjusts their cuffs.
The collector fires, misses you, and apologizes for the inconvenience.
crit: The collector shoots you precisely where you'll still be able to sign.
defeated: The collector sits down, takes out the slate with a shaking hand, and marks your account as overdue.
The collector folds, and the slate skitters to your feet, showing a very long column of figures.
joins: {Enemy} arrives straightening their cuffs, and adds your name to the slate.
stunned: {Enemy} pauses with one finger on the slate, trying to remember what they were about to charge you.
pay_worked: The collector counts it, makes a note in a little book, and thanks you for your business. There's even a receipt.
persuade_worked: You ask to see the paperwork, and you find a mistake in it. The collector sighs, closes the little book, and says they'll be in touch.
